title: I’m building a trading platform that turns plain English into backtestable strategies — looking for beta testers
author: Upbeat-Caregiver8097
selftext:
​

Hey everyone,

I’ve been working on a trading platform that lets you describe a trading strategy in plain English and turn it into executable strategy code, without having to write everything manually.

It currently support 6-8 currency pairs and 5-7 commodities and 300+ crypto coins.

The interesting part is that it doesn’t just blindly convert your idea and run a backtest.

If something in your strategy is ambiguous or unclear, it asks follow-up questions to clarify your intended rules. Once the logic is clear, it generates visual evidence on a chart showing how the strategy interprets your idea. You can review the setup and verify whether it matches what you had in mind before running the backtest.

It also goes beyond basic RSI or moving-average strategies. It supports more advanced trading concepts, including:

\- Fair Value Gaps (FVGs)

\- Breakouts and other price-action setups

\- Fibonacci-based strategies

\- More complex combinations of trading conditions

\- Multi TF strategies 

For strategy validation, it includes:

\- Walk-forward testing

\- Bootstrap testing

\- Playbook testing

\- Performance metrics and a final pass/fail verdict

You can inspect the individual trades taken during a backtest, review the result of each trade, and examine chart-based evidence to understand why a trade was generated. The goal is to make the results more transparent instead of simply showing a profit percentage and expecting you to trust it.

Once a strategy is ready, you can deploy it for live signal generation and receive signals through Telegram. Risk management is built into the signal workflow: you configure your trading capital and risk settings, and the platform calculates a suggested position amount for each signal based on those settings.

There’s also a simple voice agent that lets you interact with and control supported platform workflows using voice commands.

I’m looking for a few crypto traders who would be willing to try the current build for free and give honest feedback.

I’m particularly interested in feedback from people who build or test their own strategies and know how frustrating it can be to translate an idea into precise rules and validate it properly.

This is a work in progress, and I’m not claiming that passing a backtest guarantees future profits. I want to find out where the workflow is useful, where it falls short, and what needs improvement.

And If you have any concerns and recommendations please share with me.

If you’re interested in testing it, leave a comment or send me a DM. Constructive criticism is welcome.
